sources.fullCitation: Société des auteurs, compositeurs et éditeurs de musique. “Louis Poterat.” Musée SACEM, Les créateurs. Author, born at Troyes on 2 June 1901, died at Geneva on 6 January 1982; elected full member of SACEM on 27 April 1928; administrator of SACEM, vice-president and secretary general of the SDRM; Prix Albert Willemetz, 1946. Accessed 25 August 2026.
sources.title: Louis Poterat
sources.researchNote: Besides the dates, the register records the offices he later held in the society and in the mechanical rights body, which no other record consulted for him mentions.
